title: tp_revision_sweep.py writes per-leg records research_result.py --emit refuses (no population.n / verdict), so a measured PASS never reaches research/results; and --recollect-orphans is scheduled nowhere
note: [2026-10-16 lane P1-ATM-BACKLOG-1016, manager audit input] MEASURED: RQ-20261007-080 run 38747768830 (commit 9f401d81, all_ok true) wrote comms/research/RQ-20261007-080/38747768830/{verdict.json,records.jsonl,record-inputs.json} with verdict pass, but research/results/RQ-20261007-080/ holds only the earlier producer_failed row. Re-emitting through collect_runner_results.emit_record (the recollect path) is REFUSED by research_result.py --emit: 'record 4: population.n must be PRESENT' -- the producer's per-leg rows in records.jsonl carry arms/tp_revision_counts but no population or verdict. The grader therefore read only the stale producer_failed row and left the unit needs_review; it was session-graded PASS from the committed artifacts in the P1-ATM-BACKLOG-1016 PR. SECOND GAP: collect_runner_results.py --recollect-orphans is invoked by no workflow (grep .github/workflows: 0 hits); 2 orphans exist on main today (RQ-20261007-080/38747768830, RQ-20261014-470a-11/38663651638). BUILD: (a) tp_revision_sweep.py emits per-leg rows with population {description, n = control_trades} and verdict (per-leg improved / not; the unit's pooled verdict on a pooled row), self-test with research_result.py --emit; (b) schedule --recollect-orphans in the collector workflow (or the dispatcher's collect step) so an orphan is retried every cycle. RERUN: python3 -c "import glob,os; print([p for p in glob.glob('comms/research/*/*/record-inputs.json') if p.split('/')[3].isdigit() and not os.path.exists('research/results/%s/%s.jsonl' % (p.split('/')[2], p.split('/')[3]))])" -> [] when fixed.
